```yaml
name: Test Claude CI Workflow Instructions

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  claude-ci-instructions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v5

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Run local tests
      run: cargo test --all

    - name: Push to PR if local tests pass
      if: success()
      run: |
        echo "All local tests passed. Please push your changes to the PR."
        echo "::set-output name=push_to_pr::true"

    - name: Monitor CI results
      if: failure()
      run: |
        echo "CI failed. Please address the issues and push again."
        echo "::set-output name=push_to_pr::false"

    - name: Final check for CI resolution
      if: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha != github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
      run: |
        echo "CI is still running or has not completed yet. Please wait and try again later."
        echo "::set-output name=push_to_pr::false"
```
